project_type: Flutter mobile app (Android/iOS) with Firebase backend, expense tracking + AI chat assistant
build_system: Flutter (flutter build/run commands, pubspec.yaml for dependencies)
test_framework: Flutter test (flutter test command, or manual testing on emulator/device)
test_command: flutter analyze (for lint checks); flutter test (for unit tests, if added); manual testing on emulator (flutter run --debug)
verification_instructions: Run `flutter analyze` to catch lints and imports issues. Run `flutter pub get` to fetch dependencies after pubspec.yaml changes. Build and run on emulator: `flutter run --debug` from project root. Manually test auth flows: email signup/login, Google sign-in, GitHub sign-in, logout, navigation to home on success, navigation to login on logout.
snapshot_or_generated_files: firebase_options.dart is auto-generated by `flutterfire configure` after running it with Firebase project credentials — this file is NOT present in the repo initially. Do not write it manually; document manual setup step for developer to run flutterfire configure. pubspec.yaml is checked in and will be modified.
environment_constraints: Firebase Console setup required: enable Email/Password, Google, and GitHub sign-in providers. OAuth2 credentials for Google and GitHub must be configured in Firebase Console. flutterfire configure must be run locally to generate firebase_options.dart (output goes to lib/ automatically). GitHub OAuth: if using device flow or backend-less method, document it clearly. Google sign-in is simpler because firebase_auth + google_sign_in handle it automatically once credentials are set in Firebase Console.
contribution_requirements: All auth logic must route through AuthService (single source of truth). State is managed via AuthProvider (ChangeNotifier, similar to existing PesaTrackAIProvider pattern). Navigation after auth changes is handled in SplashScreen with Firebase Auth state stream. User data is stored in Firestore under 'users/{uid}' collection. User model must support fromFirebaseUser() factory and include authProvider field to track signup method. Error handling must use specific error messages (not generic ones). PesaTrackAIProvider must accept userId from authenticated user, not use hardcoded placeholder.
key_patterns: The app uses ChangeNotifier + Provider for state management (see PesaTrackAIProvider, ThemeProvider in main.dart). Screens follow a consistent pattern: Scaffold with AppBar, SingleChildScrollView for long forms, FilledButton for primary actions, TextButton for secondary/links. Colors come from AppConstants (ugandaGreen #11BD2E, ugandaRed #D90000). BorderRadius.circular(14) for buttons, circular(28) for cards. All text uses Theme.of(context).textTheme for consistency. Errors are displayed in red banners with red icons. Loading states use bool flags and disable buttons/inputs.
relevant_files: lib/main.dart (enable Firebase, register AuthProvider, pass userId to PesaTrackAIProvider)
pubspec.yaml (add font_awesome_flutter, conditionally add flutter_appauth if needed)
directory_structure: lib/ root contains main.dart and firebase_options.dart (auto-generated). lib/core/: constants/, providers/, routes/, theme/. lib/screens/: auth/, home/, expenses/, reports/, settings/, profile/, pesatrack_ai/, splash/. lib/data/: models/ (user_model, ai_message_model, transaction models), repositories/. lib/services/: auth_service.dart, ai_service.dart, voice_service.dart, etc. .agents/tasks/: workflow artifacts live here, not in worktree.
